messages.en: Yeah. I used to think KL was in Selangor too.
You're a real hero, coming over to help me this late at night!
Oh, it was nothing. Your car's running again, right?

senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing surprise, admiration, or amazement.

messages.en: Wow, this cake looks gorgeous! Did you make it yourself?
Yeah, it's my first try! I'll bring you some tomorrow so you can taste it.

senses.en_definition: A tangible entity or perceptible form; something that can be seen or touched.

messages.en: Is this noodle shop in the photo still around? I used to eat there all the time.
It is! I was just there yesterday. Only the sign's changed—it's the same shop.
Really? Let's go together this week. I haven't eaten there in ages.
